803-2556-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-2556-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-8103-8337.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
1479-2841-8103-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

176-4875-8227.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
176-4875-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

206-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3129-4559-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
3129-4559-5147-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2757-4365-4573.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1621-6626-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1619-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4186-4384-4506.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-4506.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2103-7174.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5078-5231-6650-7028.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-5231-6650-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2557-4136-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-4136-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

11-2928-4872-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2928-4872-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Warp spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Warp spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Warp from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

454-509-1267-4883.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{B}{B}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
454-509-1267-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
454-509-1267-4883.description:
Cause Medomai to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1940-2034-3490-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1940-2034-3490-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

957-2073-2707-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
957-2073-2707-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Stretch onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-4050-4544--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4050-4544--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4050-4544--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

3240-4050-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

411-4103-4613-5663.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-5663.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, Cayth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1429-2511-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2511-4875-5402.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1322-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

413-2382-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
413-2382-5659--33.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-2511-5263.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

526-1090-1235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1090-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

1410-4762.description:
At the beginning of combat, Captain Rex Nebula triggers, making Devoted Druid a Vehicle until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second activated ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3075-3098-3449-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
3075-3098-3449-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

147-1193.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Mythos of Illuna
147-1193.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Mythos of Illuna, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Mythos of Illuna, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

2713-3800-4772.description:
Activate Iceberg's first ability by paying {1}, putting two ice counters on it.
Activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

864-3617-4428.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
